summary: SLC-01 killers: exact path table, re-init/no-clobber, partial-fail gate, verify honesty, clean subdirectory→git root, CLI re-init exit+no-git warn, vision-fail ordering all green. Red: findRepoRoot returns on nested empty .spec-ledger before walking to parent .git, so init stamps packages/app/.spec-ledger instead of repo-root (pitch: prefer repo root).
plainSummary: Init can put the ledger inside a nested leftover folder instead of the real git repo root.

findings.gap: findRepoRoot short-circuits on exists(.spec-ledger) before walking to .git. A leftover empty packages/app/.spec-ledger (no ledger.json) makes initLedgerDetailed(sub) write ledger.json there — violates sealed negative "Git: prefer repo root". Killer: packages/ledger/src/cli/init.break.test.ts::poison: nested empty .spec-ledger must not win over parent .git
findings.plainImpact: A monorepo package could get its own ledger while the repo root stayed uninitialized.
findings.fixProposal: For init (or findRepoRoot): when choosing a root, prefer an ancestor .git over a nested .spec-ledger that lacks ledger.json. Do not treat an empty/partial .spec-ledger as an initialized repo root.
